market_question: GRVT FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: GRVT is a well-funded DEX with prominent backers; if it launches by the deadline (highly likely), its FDV will almost certainly exceed $200M, a low bar for governance tokens in this sector. The market appears to underestimate both the launch probability and the typical FDV of projects of this caliber.

Comparable DEX governance tokens routinely launch with FDVs well above $200M, even in unfavorable market conditions.
The launch deadline is over 3 years away, allowing ample time and reducing the risk of non-launch.
